scenario: [RLOW.14.7]: the order applies at every level, so the sibling a `call` continuation in a follow-up's body lowers to ([LTAC.6.1.3], [LCCO.10.1]) comes at once after that follow-up, before the next follow-up at the follow-up's own level. Rule `r` has two `after` clauses; the first one's body makes a `call` with an `on response` continuation, its correlation an author's `as` because a follow-up has no bind frame to mint a generated one in. Rule `next` follows `r` in source. The emitted sequence is `r`, the first follow-up `$r_after_0`, its continuation's sibling `$$r_after_0_response_0` (named, as every sibling is, from the rule it continues), the second follow-up `$r_after_1`, then `next`. PATH PINNED: `dsc.rete`'s `follow_up`, which pushes the follow-up's terminal and group and then its body's siblings (`siblings_of_calls`), and the parent-terminal push after `ltac_3_1_afters`, which keeps each follow-up's segment whole behind the rule's own terminal.
rules_ds:
schema SvcMethodReply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    code: Int

service svc.method:
    """stub"""
    response SvcMethodReply

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    log info "r"
    after 5_s:
        call svc.method nocooldown as "c1"
            on response.code == 200:
                log info "ok"
    after 10_s:
        log info "second"

rule next:
    Trig
->
    log info "next"
